company.name: Lumafield
company.shortDescription: Lumafield develops industrial computed tomography (CT) solutions for non-destructive testing and inspection for engineers.
company.description: Lumafield develops industrial computed tomography (CT) solutions for non-destructive testing and inspection for engineers. Its Neptune X-ray CT scanner provides detailed imaging for engineers to analyze internal structures and detect defects in various materials. The Voyager software platform enables cloud-based AI-powered analysis, offering automated inspections and collaboration tools. Triton, its high-speed CT system, is designed for rapid scanning in high-volume manufacturing environments. Lumafield’s solutions serve industries such as aerospace, automotive, electronics, and medical devices, helping improve product quality and reliability.

aiResearchSummary.text: Lumafield is advancing industrial computed tomography (CT) solutions, focusing on non-destructive testing and inspection. Their research includes developing an X-ray device with a folded field-of-view, enhancing imaging capabilities. They are also working on cloud-connected CT systems, enabling remote data processing and analysis. Additionally, Lumafield is exploring artificial intelligence for anomaly detection in CT scans, improving defect identification. Their efforts in inference of bright flat-field correction and automatic CT scan parameter setup further enhance imaging precision and efficiency.
